svg.title: Contribution city (blocks)
svg.desc: Contribution city, blocks variation: an isometric night city with one building per day of the last year, newest day near the middle, 6,100 contributions. 40 blocks of buildings with roads around them; a car with headlights drives round a block for each of 28 repositories contributed to: Jany-M/agent-spaghetti, Jany-M/repo-visualizer, Jany-M/discord-github-bot, Patcherly-Official/patcherly-connector-packages, Jany-M/airflow-simulator, Jany-M/mempalace-cloud-sync, Jany-M/Jany-M, Jany-M/ReWin, Jany-M/github-failed-actions-mcp-companion, OneByteToRuleThemAll/canvas-api-download-material, Patcherly-Official/patcherly-mcp-plugins, Patcherly-Official/php-connector, zeakd/vscode-save-as-snippet, openclaw/openclaw-windows-node, openclaw/openclaw, cloudflare/cloudflare-docs. Street lamps line the roads.

g.text: $ render-city --blocks # last 365 days of activity, downtown is latest
